meta.name: cro-methodology
meta.description: Audit websites and landing pages for conversion issues and design evidence-based A/B tests. Use when the user mentions "landing page isnt converting", "conversion rate", "A/B test", "why visitors leave", "objection handling", "bounce rate", "conversion funnel", "increase signups", or "people add to cart but dont buy". Also trigger when diagnosing why signups are low, designing experiment hypotheses, or auditing checkout flows for friction points. Covers funnel mapping, persuasion assets, and objection/counter-objection frameworks. For overall marketing strategy, see one-page-marketing. For usability issues, see ux-heuristics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计网站转化问题并设计A/B测试方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站访客多但转化少，想通过数据驱动提升转化率。
copy.tagline_en: Audit websites for conversion issues and design A/B tests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website has many visitors but few conversions, and you want data-driven improvements.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析网站或落地页的转化问题，并设计有数据支撑的 A/B 测试。它会检查页面、漏斗和用户反馈，找出访客不转化的原因，然后提出改进建议。
howto.when: 当你提到“落地页转化不好”、“转化率”、“A/B 测试”、“为什么访客离开”、“异议处理”、“跳出率”、“转化漏斗”、“增加注册”或“加购但不购买”等关键词时触发。也适用于诊断注册低、设计实验假设或审计结账流程。

say.text: 我的落地页转化率很低，帮我分析一下原因。
say.note: Claude 会启动转化审计流程。

say.text: 设计一个 A/B 测试，验证新标题是否能提高注册率。
say.note: Claude 会帮你构建假设和实验方案。

say.text: 检查我的结账流程，找出用户放弃的原因。
say.note: Claude 会审计结账步骤并指出摩擦点。
